title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: Updated step-by-step character creation: point buy, standard array, and clear limit hints.
Multiple people can now edit one sheet at once — conflicts no longer happen at the whole-section level.
Added campaigns and GM tools: encounter prep, an initiative tracker, and code-based player invites.
Added account deletion, a Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use.
The app now reports crashes and errors instead of showing a blank white screen.
